stories.title: Employer charged for ‘exploiting employees for financial benefit’ in Manitoba
stories.summary: A 48-year-old Dauphin man is facing charges following a 13-month investigation into the treatment of temporary foreign workers at his business, the RCMP said.

stories.title: Four arrested, 220 charges laid in Cape Breton organized crime probe
stories.summary: The Cape Breton police probe began in July 2025 when police were called to find a stolen vehicle that was tracked to a property in Florence, N.S.

stories.title: Scheifele ties Hawerchuk’s points record as Winnipeg Jets wallop Stars 8-3 in Dallas
stories.summary: Mark Scheifele scored twice and added an assist to tie Dale Hawerchuk's franchise points record of 929, while Dawson Mercer also stayed hot with a pair of goals in the win.

stories.title: Public cautioned of high-risk sex offender expected to live in Winnipeg
stories.summary: A high risk offender who "has been arrested approximately one month after every release" following his last three federal sentences is expected to live in Winnipeg.

stories.title: Most western Canadians say ditching time change was the ‘right move’: poll
stories.summary: After B.C., Alberta and Manitoba ditched the time change this fall, an Angus Reid Institute poll delved into how residents are reacting.

stories.title: ‘A lasting way to recognize’: Program honours 305 Canadians for service
stories.summary: A new program is recognizing the more than 300 veterans, military spouses and RCMP members who live in All Seniors Care Living Centres Canada-wide.

stories.title: Mercer scores twice as Winnipeg Jets double Hellebuyck-less Devils 4-2
stories.summary: Dawson Mercer scored twice, including the game-winner, while Nico Daws stopped 19 shots to earn his first win as a Jet.

stories.title: 104-year-old veteran that passed before Remembrance Day honoured for legacy
stories.summary: One of Manitoba's last surviving Second World War veterans died ahead of Remembrance Day.

stories.title: Sentencing underway for Winnipeg man convicted of killing five people in Langside Street shooting
stories.summary: Crown attorneys are seeking five concurrent life sentences for a man convicted of fatally shooting five people in the West Broadway neighbourhood three years ago.

stories.title: $970K worth of drugs seized in Winnipeg, Ontario in Project Pink Panther
stories.summary: A joint investigation led by the Winnipeg Police Service led to police seizing hundreds of thousands of dollars' worth of drugs, four cars and around $126,000 in cash.
